anchors.functionality: 7: works, but 3 or more majors (A1-01 no nip hard stops / drop stalls from gap 7.4, A1-02 gap set needs cover+leaf off at tilt 45, A1-03 pocket admits two edge-on candies); no blockers
anchors.manufacturability: 7: rounded down from 8; majors A1-04 (feeder servo swap needs feeder teardown) and A1-05 (0.94 crown wall at self-tap pilots), plus undocumented pod drop-in pose; 0 fastener fails, all P1S, no supports
anchors.aesthetics: 6: unfinished element in a hero view (bare 2 mm gate sheet) caps at 6; also failed: feeder edge breaks/R4 corners, exposed controller PCB, colours without meaning

issues.problem: Nip adjustment has no hard stops. Past the 5.5 thumbwheel minimum the hood swings on to hood +3.5 and hits the body at the chute entry (13,-6.25,180.8) with 2.17 to the wheel; the rig finding asks for a stop below 4.8. At the open end, drops stall from a 7.4 bare gap (8/31 at tilt 0), 13/31 and 23/31 at 7.84, 31/31 at tilt 46 from hood -3. The thumbwheel offers 5.5..12.5 against a feedable 5.5..7.0. Hood to body is 0.46 at the minimum.
issues.evidence: review/cadcheck_review.json drop rows 'drop at top of working window' hood=-1 tilt=0 8/31 stall, 'threshold' hood=-1.5 13/31 & 23/31; cad q sweep PRT_hood PRT_launcher_body PIV_hood 1 4 0.5 -> 0.005 at 3.5, -1.205 at 4.0 at (13.0,-6.25,180.8); review/r02_hood_hits_body_hood+3.5_x20.png
issues.fix: Printed min-gap stop land (3 x 20) on the guard under the hood back face at hood +1.3 (gap 5.3), on a broad face away from the chute entry, with the bay opened to keep >=0.5 hood-body clearance. Thumbwheel static travel stop at gap 7.2 (hood about -0.8) via a stud collar or STUD_L/SEAT_H; leaf lift (1.5) stays free. Set PIV_hood to the stops, declare them as fits contact, add distances ray and drop_tests rows at both.

issues.problem: Setting the nip gap needs the nip cover and the leaf spring removed, which is only possible at tilt 45 (at tilt 0 the cover is blocked by PRT_groove_cap at 14 mm). This violates the brief's adjust-without-covers rule, and the gap is set with no leaf preload. The service row has no pose.
issues.evidence: review/cadcheck_review.json slide 'nip cover + leaf off down at tilt 0' blocked_by PRT_groove_cap at 14 mm; BOM section 8; checks.json service 'set the nip gap' has no pose
issues.fix: 22 x 7 finger slot in PRT_nip_cover over the thumbwheel rim (TW_R 8.5), rim >= 2 mm proud; or move the leaf root to the guard so the cover is cosmetic. Prove access with a ray or service row at tilt 0 and 45 with the cover on; add pose {PIV_tilt:45} to any cover-off row.

issues.problem: The Ø15 x 8 disc pocket admits two edge-on 13 x 7 candies side by side, and both pass under the baffle ramp (5.5 above the disc). The result is a double feed or a jam, the v1 failure the brief names.
issues.evidence: cad q dist ZMM_lenA PRT_feeder_disc = 0.081 (true lentil pair); ZMM_ellA = -3.132 mm3 (ellipsoid pair) on /tmp/rv1/model_mm.blend from review/add_mm_probe.py; cad q ray 10.5,18.187,268 -> pocket R 7.39-7.5
issues.fix: POCKET_D 15 -> 14.4 plus a 1 x 45 rim chamfer. Re-run the lentil-pair probe (must overlap), stacks 'pocket over outlet' (outlet 16) and the 3 index rows.

issues.problem: Feeder servo swap needs a feeder teardown. FST_fhorn_ctr (driven up through the pinion) is blocked by PRT_feeder_housing at 8 mm for the straight bit and the L-key at all poses with the lobe cover off. The BOM row 'remove the lobe cover (2 screws)' is an overclaim; the real path is jar off, 4 L-key feed-mount screws, flip, 2 floor-plate screws, disc out. No service row existed.
issues.evidence: review/cadcheck_review.json service 'REVIEW feeder servo swap' FAIL: FST_fhorn_ctr straight bit blocked by PRT_feeder_housing at 8.0 mm, L-key short leg blocked 8.0 mm
issues.fix: Ø6 access hole on the pinion axis (-55.5,0) through the housing floor and the beam for a straight 2 mm hex bit from below (check reach at tilt 45), or retain the pinion on the horn with the 4 M2 screws only and drop the centre screw (the servo already lifts +Z clear for 60 mm). Add a service row for FST_fhorn_ctr.

issues.problem: The crown wall between the (-36,±18) M3 self-tap pilots and the pinion chamber (R24.35) is 0.94. After threading about 0.65 remains, and it will bulge into the chamber where the pinion tips run at 0.35.
issues.evidence: checks.parts PRT_feeder_crown thin_wall_where [0.94, (-37.6,±16.5,266.2)]; warn 'PRT_feeder_crown: 40 wall samples < 1.6 mm (min 0.94)'
issues.fix: Move IF_FEED_BOLTS (-36,±18) to (-36,±21), leaving a 2.8 wall after threading. Re-run fasteners access (L-key arc) and the parts wall row.

issues.problem: Step 7: the pod drops into the post U-slots only at tilt 10..35 deg. At tilt 0/-3/46 the journal-plate stop lug hits PRT_post_R at 2 mm and the hinge head at 14 mm. Neither the BOM nor assembly_order gives a pose.
issues.evidence: review/cadcheck_review.json slide 'pod lift at tilt -3/46' and 'step 7 reverse' blocked_by PRT_post_R at 2 mm; tilt 10/22.5/35 clear (min 0.14-0.2)
issues.fix: BOM step 7: lower the pod nose-up about 20 deg. Add a slide_out row with pose {PIV_tilt:20}.

issues.problem: Magnet centring stack worst case 0.40 against the 0.30 limit (RSS 0.17).
issues.fix: Jig spigot 7.9 (tol 0.05) and Plink pegs 2.4 in 2.5 holes (tol 0.05); worst case becomes 0.30.

issues.problem: Knife-thin functional edges: jar_valve 0.02 at the baffle bottom, jar_gate 0.77, hood 0.91 at the nip, journal_plate 0.95. The journal_plate 48 mm bridge (153 mm2 ceiling) is unexplained; the flywheel '72 mm bridge' is a 1 mm flange ring and should be declared.
issues.evidence: checks.parts thin_wall_where: valve (16.6,-4.4,272.9) 0.02, hood (20,6.3,134.4) 0.91, journal_plate (34.2,29.7,222.2) 0.95; journal_plate max_bridge_span 48.4
issues.fix: 0.8 flats on ramp and blade edges (min wall 1.2), hood nip edge >= 1.6, journal-plate ceiling as a 45 deg roof.

issues.problem: The gate is a bare 2 mm grey sheet with a ridge tab, 8 mm proud of the valve in hero views. Open, it hangs about 60 mm out with 17 mm in its guides and has no detent or stop (with the valve ignored it slides 110 mm free). The running (open) state is never modelled or checked.
issues.fix: R6-cornered, EB 1.0 pull tab flush with the valve OD to ±1; detent bumps at 0 and 52; model PIV_gate (prismatic 0..52) so interference and renders cover the open state.

issues.problem: The feeder breaks the form language: parts/feeder.py has no bevel calls, so the adapter, valve, gate, crown and disc are sharp-edged, and the crown and cover use R4 corners that are not in the declared set (CR 6, BASE 30).
issues.evidence: grep bevel parts/feeder.py: 0 hits (base/pan_stage/launcher use P.EB 1.0); parts/feeder.py:166 'plan corners R4'
issues.fix: EB 1.0 on every feeder part; R6 corners or add R4 to the declared set.

issues.problem: The servo-controller PCB is exposed through a 52 x 24 notch in the +X base wall (side and iso views). The jar is rendered opaque grey, which hides the glass hero element.
issues.evidence: cad q ray 200,{30,50,70},{10,18} -1,0,0 -> BUY_servo_controller at x 111-116.5; side.png, iso.png
issues.fix: Port-only cutouts (switch and terminal) plus a printed bezel instead of the open notch; transmissive material for BUY_jar in the view set.

issues.problem: The two PLA colours don't encode anything. Grey covers the structure plus the flywheel, disc, pinion, gate and hood; terracotta covers the pod, feeder, valve and every gear.
issues.fix: B for every moving part and A for the static structure (or B for the whole payload path); reassign the parts.

service 'set the nip gap' has no pose; the nip cover only comes off at tilt 45 (blocked by PRT_groove_cap at 14 mm at tilt 0)
drop_tests cover only the home PIV_hood pose; at the extremes the drop stalls from gap 7.4 (review rows)
distances nip ray only at home; no rows at the adjustment ends, and the fixed ray origin misses the hood at hood <= -3
service has no feeder-servo-swap row although the BOM claims one; added, and it fails (FST_fhorn_ctr blocked)
assembly_order step 7 (pod drop-in) needs a pose; blocked at tilt 0
fits PRT_post_R x PRT_journal_plate and PRT_base_shell x PRT_turntable contact:true also cover the R15/R15.2 and R20/R20.3 journals, so a journal rub would be hidden
stability: the tool evaluates 1 pose (pose_grid cap 27 with 5 driven joints); the designer's 64-pose cg_grid (worst 29.8 deg) is accepted as evidence
